title: 第15章 采购单第16章 楚星河的人缘
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 别人都去藏功塔学习功法，但楚星河没有这个机会，这一度让楚星河气得想骂娘。
那可是藏功塔啊！
昊天宗最重要的地方之一！
自己要是在那个地方来个一把火……好家伙，那还不得直接起飞。
可惜藏功塔自己去不了，只能来昊天宫这边跟随宗主学习昊天战意，尽管昊天战意很吸引人，可是远不如火烧藏功塔来的更刺激啊。
“星河，你听好了，昊天战意的传承乃是我昊天宗最强传承，但此功法没有我的允许绝对不可外传，否则……”
楚星河激动了……机会来了……否则怎么样？废掉修为逐出宗门吗？
“否则当受凌迟之刑而死！”
尼玛，这是直接把自己所有的后路都给堵死了。
“弟子谨记。”
“那好，接下来我亲自传授你昊天战意。”
顾明朝满意的点了点头随后也不多说什么，开始一点点的传授楚星河昊天战意。
不得不说，昊天战意是真的最顶级功法，其中蕴含了各种锻体之术，修灵之术以及各种战斗的法门，每一种拿出来都绝对是最顶尖的存在。
绝不是藏功塔之中寻常的功法可以与之相比的。
因为一般功法，都是比较单一的，修炼功法是修炼功法，而战斗的武技又是独立存在的。
所以在藏功塔选择功法不光要选择修炼功法，还得选择适合自己的武技，一旦有丝毫的选错门路，那么恭喜你，不说重头再来，至少也是事倍功半啊。
可昊天战意就完全没有这个顾虑了，昊天战意之中不光拥有修炼之法，还有各种武技的搭配，这是昊天宗一代代传承至今无数先祖们经验总结出来的。
什么武技搭配什么运行路线那都是最优选择，可以说昊天战意就属于是一键完美匹配。
而且更让楚星河难以置信的是，你说昊天战意这么吊炸天的功法，按理说修炼起来应该是最繁琐的吧。
可恰恰相反！
这功法远比寻常功法还要简单很多，用顾明朝的话说就是，先祖大智慧，已做到化繁为简。
整整一天的时间，顾明朝传授了楚星河昊天战意，虽然学的脑袋嗡嗡的，可楚星河还是完美的记住了一切。
这可能跟药圣传承有关，自从得到药圣传承之后，楚星河发现自己就有了过目不忘的本领，所以学习各种东西也快了很多。
“接下来你要勤修苦练，如果遇到什么不懂的，可以随时来昊天宫询问我。”
顾明朝对楚星河还是极为满意的。
本来他觉得楚星河要学到昊天战意至少要三天时间，可万万没想到，这小子天赋如此之好，一天就学懂了，比他当年还要优秀不少。
面对如此优秀的楚星河，虽然没有能够成为自己的亲传弟子，但顾明朝已经下定决心，必要好好培养楚星河，毕竟亲传弟子不过是个名头罢了。
拜别了顾明朝，楚星河回到灵鹤宫，药王宫主体已经彻底建设完成，各种装修也进行的七七八八，现在就是各种大采购的时间，什么丹炉……药材……各种所需要的消耗品每日采购的份额那绝对都是天文数字。
楚星河每天都可以看到来自各方的商会在药王宫进进出出，能拿到昊天宗的订单，那绝对是天大的好事。
昊天宗突出一个财大气粗，只要你东西足够好，昊天宗就敢给你足够高的价格。
回到房间，一脸疲惫的冯飞正趴在桌上算着账，甚至连楚星河回来都没注意到。
走到冯飞身边，冯飞才看到是楚星河。
“星河师弟，学了一天怎么样？”
content_en:
Everyone else went to the Tibetan Kung Fu Pagoda to learn Kung Fu, but Chu Xinghe didn't have this opportunity. This made Chu Xinghe so angry that he wanted to curse.
That's a hidden power tower!
One of the most important places in Haotian Sect!
If I want to make a scene in that place... my dear, I won't be able to take off directly.
It's a pity that I can't go to the Hidden Skills Pagoda by myself, so I can only come to Haotian Palace to learn Haotian's fighting spirit from the sect master. Although Haotian's fighting spirit is very attractive, it is far less exciting than burning the Hidden Skills Pagoda.
"Xinghe, listen carefully, the inheritance of Haotian's fighting spirit is the strongest inheritance of our Haotian Sect, but this technique must not be passed on to others without my permission, otherwise..."
Chu Xinghe was excited...the opportunity had come...otherwise what? Abandon your cultivation and expel you from the sect?
"Otherwise, you will be punished by Lingchi and die!"
Chu Xinghe: "..."
Damn it, this is directly blocking all your escape routes.
"Disciple, please remember this."
"Okay, then I will personally teach you Haotian's fighting spirit."
Gu Mingchao nodded with satisfaction and said nothing more, and began to teach Chu Xinghe Haotian's fighting spirit bit by bit.
It has to be said that Haotian's fighting spirit is truly the top-notch technique. It contains various body-building techniques, spiritual cultivation techniques, and various fighting techniques. Each of them is definitely the top-notch existence.
It is definitely not comparable to the ordinary skills in the Hidden Skills Pagoda.
Because the general skills are relatively simple, practicing skills is practicing skills, and fighting martial arts exist independently.
Therefore, when choosing a technique in the Tibetan Kung Fu Pagoda, you must not only choose the practice technique, but also choose the martial arts that suits you. If you choose the wrong path at all, congratulations, not to mention starting over, at least you will get twice the result with half the effort.
But Haotian's fighting spirit has no such worries at all. Haotian's fighting spirit not only has the method of cultivation, but also the combination of various martial arts. This is the experience of countless ancestors passed down from generation to generation in the Haotian sect.
Any combination of martial arts and any running route is the best choice. It can be said that Haotian's fighting spirit is a perfect match with one click.
What’s even more unbelievable to Chu Xinghe is that you said that Haotian Zhanyi’s sky-shattering technique should be the most cumbersome to practice.
But just the opposite!
This technique is far simpler than ordinary techniques. In the words of Gu Mingchao, it means that the great wisdom of our ancestors has reduced complexity into simplicity.
For a whole day, Gu Mingchao taught Chu Xinghe Haotian's fighting spirit. Although his head was buzzing from learning, Chu Xinghe still remembered everything perfectly.
This may be related to the inheritance of the Medicine Saint. Since receiving the inheritance of the Medicine Saint, Chu Xinghe found that he has the ability to remember everything, so he can learn various things much faster.
"Next, you have to practice hard. If you encounter something you don't understand, you can come to Haotian Palace and ask me at any time."
Gu Mingchao was still extremely satisfied with Chu Xinghe.
He originally thought that it would take at least three days for Chu Xinghe to learn Haotian's fighting spirit, but he never expected that this kid was so talented and could learn it in one day, making him much better than he was back then.
Facing such an outstanding Chu Xinghe, although he was not able to become his direct disciple, Gu Mingchao had already made up his mind to train Chu Xinghe well. After all, a direct disciple was just a name.
After bidding farewell to Gu Mingchao, Chu Xinghe returned to Linghe Palace. The main body of Yaowang Palace has been completely completed, and various decorations have also been carried out. Now is the time for various large-scale purchases. The daily purchases of pill furnaces... medicinal materials... and various required consumables are absolutely astronomical.
Chu Xinghe could see chambers of commerce from all over the world coming in and out of Yaowang Palace every day. It was definitely a great thing to get an order from Haotian Sect.
The Haotian Sect stands out as a wealthy person. As long as your goods are good enough, the Haotian Sect will dare to give you a high enough price.
Back in the room, Feng Fei, who looked exhausted, was lying on the table calculating accounts, and didn't even notice Chu Xinghe's return.
When he walked to Feng Fei, Feng Fei saw that it was Chu Xinghe.
"Junior brother Xinghe, how about studying for a day?"
